# filename: fetch_etf_endpoints.py
import yfinance as yf
import pandas as pd

tickers = ["VGT", "MGK", "VONG"]
start_date = "2013-01-01"
end_date = "2023-12-31"

rows = []
for t in tickers:
    df = yf.download(t, start=start_date, end=end_date, auto_adjust=True)
    first_day = df.index.min()
    last_day = df.index.max()
    start_price = float(df.loc[first_day, "Close"])  # adjusted close via auto_adjust
    end_price = float(df.loc[last_day, "Close"])    # adjusted close via auto_adjust
    rows.append((t, start_price, end_price))

for t, s, e in rows:
    print(f"ETF: {t} | Start: {s:.2f} | End: {e:.2f}")
print("Data source: Yahoo Finance (yfinance, auto_adjust=True)")
```

import yfinance as yf
import pandas as pd

symbols = ["VGT", "MGK", "VONG"]
start_date = "2013-01-01"
end_date = "2023-12-31"

for t in symbols:
    df = yf.download(t, start=start_date, end=end_date, auto_adjust=True)
    # Take last close in each calendar year
    yearly = df["Close"].resample("Y").last()
    yoy = yearly.pct_change() * 100
    print(f"Annual YoY returns for {t} (2013-2023):")
    # Print each year label and percentage (skip NaN for first year)
    years = list(range(2013, 2024))
    for i, y in enumerate(years):
        if i == 0:
            continue
        val = yoy.iloc[i-1]
        print(f"{y}: {val:.2f}%")
    print("")
```
